 Project: example-project                                       kata カタ · dev
kata カタ [jobs] runs workflows

A job is a schedule plus an action.
A workflow is a named list of steps jobs can run.
A run is what an executor recorded; runs remember the definition revision they
used.
kata cron --help shows creation examples.

Cron keys
j/k    move
↵/l    open
/      filter
n/e    new/edit
p      pause
d/u    archive/restore
h/esc  kata
r      refresh
1-4    tabs
?      help
q      quit

Job keys
n  new job
e  edit the job
p  pause or resume
d  archive (asks first)
u  restore an archived job
a  show archived jobs
